candidate.description: Structural completeness of 200-people-worker PROCESS.md (v5.0.0) against the Unified Template v6.0.0 invariant set for executable processes, evaluated across 10 invariant set comparators from US run-003.
candidate.scope: PROCESS.md (primary), heir.yaml (identity), OSAM.md (data schema standalone), src/ (implementation evidence). Evaluated against 24 US layers, 10 invariant set comparators.

elements.description: PROCESS.md exists at declared CTB position factory/outreach/200-people-worker/ with 14 numbered sections. All section content maps to the three clusters (Identity=Thing, Contract=Flow, Governance=Change) but cluster grouping is implicit through section annotations, not explicit cluster headers.
elements.format: Markdown file, 585 lines, 14 sections numbered §1-§14, footer with document control

elements.description: Three clusters (Identity, Contract, Governance) are represented through constituent sections but lack explicit cluster grouping headers. §1-§2 map to Identity, §3-§6 to Contract, §7-§14 to Governance. Annotations provide implicit mapping (e.g., §1: 'What is this thing?').
elements.format: Implicit — section annotations serve as cluster indicators; no '## Identity Cluster' / '## Contract Cluster' / '## Governance Cluster' parent headers

elements.description: §1 Identity table with 11 fields: Process ID (PROC-200), Name, Business Silo, CTB Position, ORBT, Strikes, Last Deployed, BAR Reference, Deployed URL, Cron, Runtime. Missing from L5 spec: 'Authority' and 'Last Modified'. 'Runtime' approximates 'Medium' but uses different label.
elements.format: Markdown table, 11 rows, 2 columns (Field, Value)

elements.description: heir.yaml present with all 8 HEIR fields. Identity inconsistency: heir.yaml declares hub_id='PROC-PEOPLE' and process_number='200' while PROCESS.md declares Process ID='PROC-200'. Two different identifiers for the same process.
elements.format: YAML, 8 HEIR fields + supplementary fields (tool_priority, source_trust, enrichment_priority, reachability_gate, slots, movement_detection, acceptance_criteria)

elements.description: §2 'WHY THIS EXISTS' — names what breaks (no personalized outreach), names downstream consumers (201, 202, 700), describes business outcome (dead inventory → actionable contacts).
elements.format: Prose block, 2 paragraphs, references downstream dependencies

elements.description: §3 Two-Question Intake — both questions answered. Trigger: slot where has_name=0. Source: three-gate chain (A: recon, B: Hunter, C: Startpage). References Bedrock §7.
elements.format: Numbered list, 2 items with bold question labels, each answered with specific trigger/source

elements.description: §3 Middle table with 3 rows (Gate A, Gate B, Gate C). All 5 required columns present: Step, Input, What Happens, Output, Tool Used. Each row fully populated.
elements.format: Markdown table, 3 rows, 5 columns (Step, Input, What Happens, Output, Tool Used)

elements.description: §3 Output table with 10 fields written on gate success. Names downstream consumers (201, 202). Clear boundary note: '200 fills NAME + TITLE only'.
elements.format: Markdown table, 10 rows, 3 columns (Field Written, Value, When)

elements.description: §3 Circle (Bedrock §5) — full feedback loop described: person found → slot updated → workbench refreshed → 201/202 → 700 → response → slot cleared → re-run. Includes sigma tracking trigger (fill rate plateau for 3 runs).
elements.format: Prose block, 1 paragraph + monitoring trigger

elements.description: §5 READ table present with 1 source row (slot_workbench) plus 21-row column detail table with C&V classification per column. Comprehensive column-level documentation.
elements.format: Markdown table (1 row summary + 21 row column detail), join key = outreach_id

elements.description: §5 WRITE table with 2 rows documenting the 10 fields written and conditions.
elements.format: Markdown table, 2 rows, 3 columns (Table, What It Writes, When)

elements.description: §5 Join chain declared: slot_workbench.outreach_id (self-contained single table). All reads and writes target slot_workbench.
elements.format: Code block with tree notation, traces to outreach_id

elements.description: §5 Forbidden paths table with 6 entries covering: gate order enforcement, name completeness, dependency ordering, Neon write prohibition, process boundary enforcement, email write prohibition.
elements.format: Markdown table, 6 rows, 2 columns (Action, Why)

elements.description: §6 Constants & Variables declaration with mathematical definitions (P(x;θ), r(x), stability, domestication), 6 step-level comparators with k_i values, 7 named constants table, variables list. Partially covers DMJ Define function through the constants table but uses comparator format rather than the 5-column DMJ schema (Element, ID, Format, Description, C-or-V).
elements.format: Mixed: math code block + 4 comparator tables (per gate) + constants table (4 columns: Constant, Comparator, Primitive, k_i) + variables bullet list

elements.description: ABSENT as formal DMJ structure. The C&V section (§6) performs the Define function implicitly through its constants table, but does not use the L19 schema (5 columns: Element, ID, Format, Description, C-or-V). Elements are listed as constants with comparators rather than as decomposed raw subject elements.
elements.format: Missing — should be 5-column table per L19 invariant

elements.description: ABSENT. No explicit Map table (Source, Target, Transform) per L20 schema. The OSAM section provides column-level read/write mapping but not in DMJ Map format. No transform-type classification (direct, classify, parse).
elements.format: Missing — should be 3-column table per L20 invariant

elements.description: PARTIALLY PRESENT. The OSAM join chain (§5) declares the join path to outreach_id, but not as a formal DMJ Join table (Join Path, Type, Description) per L21 schema. No join type classification (direct, indirect, fuzzy). No back-propagation rule documented.
elements.format: Present as OSAM join chain, missing as formal DMJ Join table per L21

elements.description: §7 Stop conditions table with 6 entries. 3 of 6 canonical conditions present (5+ errors, data quality threshold via CAPTCHA, Strike 3). Missing canonical conditions: (1) can't answer Two-Question Intake, (2) data schema gap, (4) budget cap. 3 domain-specific conditions present.
elements.format: Markdown table, 6 rows, 2 columns (Condition, Action)

elements.description: §9 Smoke test with 6 numbered steps, each with expected result. Three Primitives Check present with all 3 questions (Thing, Flow, Change). Includes SQL verification queries.
elements.format: Code block with 6 numbered steps + expected results, followed by Three Primitives Check (3 questions with binary answers)

elements.description: §10 Process metrics table with 7 metrics defined BEFORE build. All use 'BASELINE' for first run with targets set after baseline. Tool scorecard table present (empty — no runs yet).
elements.format: Markdown table, 7 rows, 5 columns (Metric, Unit, First Run=Baseline, Target, Tolerance)

elements.description: §10 Sigma tracking table present with 5 metrics. All cells empty (no runs yet — correct for BUILD state). Trend semantics documented (tightening/flat/expanding).
elements.format: Markdown table, 5 rows, 6 columns (Metric, Run 1-3, Trend, Action). Empty values expected at BUILD.

elements.description: §10 ORBT gate rules table with all 4 transitions: BUILD→OPERATE (3 runs + auditor), OPERATE→REPAIR (any metric outside tolerance), REPAIR→OPERATE (fix + auditor), Any→TROUBLESHOOT/TRAIN (Strike 3). Auditor ≠ builder explicitly stated.
elements.format: Markdown table, 4 rows, 3 columns (From, To, Gate). Auditor separation note below table.

elements.description: §11 Execution trace schema with all 14 required fields: trace_id, run_id, step, target, actual, delta, status, error_code, error_message, tools_used, duration_ms, cost_cents, timestamp, signed_by. Append-only constraint declared. Run summary schema also present.
elements.format: Markdown table, 14 rows, 4 columns (Field, Description, Format, Required). Append-only rules listed.

elements.description: §12 Logbook with birth certificate schema (11 fields), subsequent entry schema (13 fields), 7 rules. 'No logbook during BUILD' rule present. Auditor ≠ builder enforced.
elements.format: Two tables (birth certificate + subsequent entries) + rules list

elements.description: §13 Failure Pattern Registry table with 1 resolved entry (FP-001: SCHEMA_MISMATCH). Strike rules documented (1→repair, 2→scrutiny, 3→T/T). Airworthiness Directive schema with 8 fields and 5 issuance requirements.
elements.format: Markdown table (8 columns) + strike rules + AD schema (8 fields) + issuance checklist (5 items)

elements.description: §14 Session log table with 8 entries from 2026-03-29 to 2026-04-02. 3 columns (Date, What Was Done, LBB Record). Links to LBB records where available.
elements.format: Markdown table, 8 rows, 3 columns

elements.description: OSAM.md (standalone file) references OLD schema (people_company_slot, people_people_master, intake_people_staging) while PROCESS.md §5 references NEW schema (slot_workbench). The standalone OSAM.md has not been updated to match the v3 rewrite. This is a schema drift — two files in the same directory declaring different table structures.
elements.format: Schema mismatch between OSAM.md and PROCESS.md §5

elements.description: heir.yaml declares hub_id='PROC-PEOPLE' while PROCESS.md §1 declares Process ID='PROC-200'. Two different identifiers for the same process. heir.yaml also references governing_engine='law/doctrine/TIER0_DOCTRINE.md' which does not match the current doctrine file name (TIER0_MATHEMATICAL_PRINCIPLE.md or FOUNDATIONAL_BEDROCK.md).
elements.format: Value conflict between two identity sources (heir.yaml vs PROCESS.md §1)

missing_cluster_headers.measurement: Count of three required cluster grouping headers (Identity Cluster, Contract Cluster, Governance Cluster) absent as explicit structural sections. 0 = all present, 3 = none present.
missing_cluster_headers.detail: Sections map to clusters through annotations but no explicit cluster-level grouping headers exist. 14 sections present but organized flat (§1-§14) rather than grouped under 3 cluster parents. Scored 1: content complete, structural grouping absent.

missing_identity_fields.measurement: Count of 18 required identity fields (10 process + 8 HEIR per L5 format) that are absent or empty. Process spec: ID, Name, Medium, Business Silo, CTB Position, ORBT, Strikes, Authority, Last Modified, Reference. HEIR spec: sovereign_ref, hub_id, ctb_placement, imo_topology, cc_layer, services, secrets_provider, acceptance_criteria.
missing_identity_fields.detail: Missing process fields: 'Authority' (not present), 'Last Modified' (not present — 'Last Deployed' is a different field). 'Runtime' accepted as equivalent to 'Medium'. HEIR: 8/8 present in heir.yaml. Total: 16/18 = 2 missing. Additionally, hub_id value mismatch (PROC-PEOPLE vs PROC-200) is a consistency defect, not a missing field.

imo_declaration_gaps.measurement: Count of IMO sub-component failures out of 4: (1) both intake questions answered, (2) Middle table ≥1 row with all 5 columns, (3) Output block names downstream consumer, (4) Circle block present. 0 = all pass.
imo_declaration_gaps.detail: All 4 sub-components pass. Two-Question Intake: both answered with specific trigger and source. Middle table: 3 rows, all 5 columns populated. Output: 10-field table + downstream consumers named (201, 202, 700). Circle: full feedback loop described with monitoring trigger.

osam_schema_gaps.measurement: Count of OSAM sub-component failures out of 3: (1) READ table ≥1 row, (2) join chain traces to declared spine ID, (3) forbidden paths section present. 0 = all pass.
osam_schema_gaps.detail: All 3 sub-components pass in PROCESS.md §5. READ table: 1 summary row + 21-row column detail. Join chain: slot_workbench.outreach_id declared. Forbidden paths: 6 entries. Note: standalone OSAM.md is stale (old schema) but the PROCESS.md §5 OSAM section is complete.

dmj_structure_gaps.measurement: Count of DMJ sub-component failures out of 3: (1) Define table (L19) non-empty with 5-column schema, (2) Map table (L20) present referencing Define element IDs, (3) Join path (L21) reaches spine with type classification. 0 = all pass, 3 = all absent.
dmj_structure_gaps.detail: All 3 DMJ tables are absent in their specified format. (1) No formal Define table with 5 columns (Element, ID, Format, Description, C-or-V) — the C&V section uses comparator format instead. (2) No Map table (Source, Target, Transform). (3) No Join path table (Join Path, Type, Description). The C&V section and OSAM section partially cover this function but not in DMJ schema. This is the largest structural gap.

missing_canonical_guardrails.measurement: Count of 6 canonical stop conditions from Bedrock §6/§8 that are absent: (1) can't answer Two-Question Intake, (2) data schema gap, (3) 5 consecutive errors, (4) budget cap, (5) data quality below threshold, (6) Strike 3. 0 = all present.
missing_canonical_guardrails.detail: Present: (3) errors >5% ≈ consecutive errors, (5) CAPTCHA >10% ≈ data quality, (6) Strike 3 explicitly. Missing: (1) can't answer Two-Question Intake — not listed as halt condition, (2) data schema gap — not listed, (4) budget cap — not listed. 6 rows exist but 3 are domain-specific substitutions rather than canonical conditions.

verification_gaps.measurement: Count of verification sub-component failures out of 3: (1) ≥1 numbered step exists, (2) each step has expected result, (3) Three Primitives Check with all 3 questions. 0 = all pass.
verification_gaps.detail: All 3 pass. 6 numbered steps each with expected result. Three Primitives Check: Thing (slots exist?), Flow (gate chain reaches slot?), Change (has_name set? readiness_tier updated?). All three questions binary with clear pass/fail.

measurement_gaps.measurement: Count of measurement sub-component failures out of 3: (1) metrics table ≥1 metric defined before build, (2) sigma tracking active/present, (3) ORBT gate rules with all 4 transitions. 0 = all pass.
measurement_gaps.detail: All 3 pass. (1) 7 metrics defined before build with BASELINE for first run. (2) Sigma tracking table present with 5 metrics — empty is correct for BUILD state. (3) ORBT gate rules: 4 transitions defined, auditor ≠ builder enforced.

trace_schema_gaps.measurement: Count of execution trace deficiencies out of 2: (1) missing fields from 14-field schema, (2) append-only constraint not declared. 0 = complete.
trace_schema_gaps.detail: Both pass. All 14 fields declared with description, format, and required flag. Append-only explicitly stated in 5-point rules section. Run summary schema also present as derived view.

orbt_gate_gaps.measurement: Count of ORBT sub-component failures out of 3: (1) ORBT state declared in identity, (2) all 4 transitions defined with gate conditions, (3) auditor ≠ builder enforced. 0 = all pass.
orbt_gate_gaps.detail: All 3 pass. ORBT=BUILD declared in §1. 4 transitions: BUILD→OPERATE, OPERATE→REPAIR, REPAIR→OPERATE, Any→T/T. Builder-auditor separation explicitly stated.
